---
title: "Check a fit"
description: "Read fit status, standard errors and residual diagnostics."
---

Read `fit_status` and `inference_available` before interpreting standard
errors. The following six artificial observations illustrate a consensus
fit with one zero modifier.

```{r}
library(CircularRegression)

d <- data.frame(
  y = c(-0.6, 0.4, 0, -0.2, 0.5, 0.1),
  x = 0,
  z = c(1, 0.7, 0, 1, 1.5, 1)
)
fit <- consensus(y ~ x:z, d)
fit$fit_status
fit$inference_available
cbind(
  model = sqrt(diag(vcov(fit))),
  sandwich = sqrt(diag(vcov(fit, robust = TRUE)))
)
```

The sandwich uses independent observation scores. In this example the
third fitted direction and residual are undefined because the resultant
length is zero. The index plot leaves a gap at that observation. The PIT
plot (`type = "pit"`) uses the residuals with defined directions and their
matching fitted concentrations.

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=3, fig.alt="Residuals in observation order, with a gap at observation three and a note that one residual is undefined."}
plot(fit, type = "index")
```
